parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.lead:
A sinusoidal carrier wave has a constant amplitude and a frequency of 1.2MHz. The carrier wave is modulated by signal wave such that a 1.0V displacement of the signal wave causes a change in frequency of 25kHz.

The signal wave has frequency 8.0kHz and amplitude 2.0V.
parts.text: State the name of this type of modulation of the carrier wave.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
For this modulated carrier wave, determine the variation, if any, in:

1. its amplitude

2. its frequency.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.lead:
An audio signal is transmitted by means of a modulated radio wave.

The variation with frequency of the amplitude of the radio wave is shown in Fig. 4.1.

[[fig:f1]]

For this transmission, determine:
parts.text: the wavelength, in km, of the carrier wave

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: the frequency of the audio signal.

figures.caption: Fig. 4.1
figures.alt: A graph of amplitude against frequency / kHz with vertical lines at 225, 240 and 255 kHz, the line at 240 kHz being tallest.
